items.front: ISRO evolution — key years and founder?
items.back: INCOSPAR 1962 (Vikram Sarabhai) → ISRO 15 Aug 1969 → Department of Space 1972. SDSC named after Satish Dhawan.
items.examPoint: ISRO evolution — INCOSPAR 1962, ISRO 1969, Sarabhai & Dhawan, Dept of Space 1972
items.source: ISRO

items.front: Launch vehicles — role of PSLV, GSLV, LVM3, SSLV?
items.back: PSLV = workhorse (LEO/SSO, MOM); GSLV = GEO comsats (cryo stage); LVM3 = heaviest (Chandrayaan-3); SSLV = small sats (~500 kg).
items.examPoint: Launch vehicles — SLV/ASLV/PSLV/GSLV/LVM3/SSLV roles & payload capacity
items.source: ISRO

items.front: Chandrayaan-3 — what first, when, key names?
items.back: 23 Aug 2023: first soft landing near lunar SOUTH POLE; India 4th to soft-land. Lander Vikram, rover Pragyan, site Shiv Shakti Point.
items.examPoint: Chandrayaan-3 (Aug 2023) — first south-pole soft landing; Vikram/Pragyan/Shiv Shakti Point
items.source: ISRO

items.front: Aditya-L1 — where positioned and when?
items.back: India's first solar mission; halo orbit around Sun-Earth L1 (~1.5 M km); reached L1 on 6 Jan 2024. Key payload VELC.
items.examPoint: Aditya-L1 — solar mission in halo orbit around Sun-Earth L1 (Jan 2024)
items.source: ISRO

items.front: SpaDeX — what capability and rank?
items.back: Autonomous in-space docking; docked 16 Jan 2025 → India 4th nation to dock. Enables BAS & Chandrayaan-4.
items.examPoint: SpaDeX (Dec 2024–Jan 2025) — space docking; India 4th nation to dock
items.source: ISRO

items.front: NISAR (Jul 2025) — what is it?
items.back: ISRO-NASA Earth-observation satellite; first with dual-frequency (L-band NASA + S-band ISRO) SAR; monitors land/ice/hazards.
items.examPoint: NISAR (Jul 2025) — ISRO-NASA dual-frequency (L & S band) SAR Earth-observation satellite
items.source: ISRO/NASA

items.front: Gaganyaan — goal and TV-D1?
items.back: 3 crew to ~400 km LEO on human-rated LVM3; TV-D1 (Oct 2023) tested crew escape; 4 IAF pilots named Feb 2024.
items.examPoint: Gaganyaan — human spaceflight, TV-D1 abort test, 4-astronaut crew, timeline
items.source: ISRO

items.front: NavIC (IRNSS) — coverage vs GPS?
items.back: Regional system: India + ~1,500 km around it (not global). Standard + Restricted services; newer sats add L1 civilian signal.
items.examPoint: NavIC/IRNSS vs GPS — regional coverage & applications
items.source: ISRO

items.front: ISRO vision years: space station and Moon landing?
items.back: Bharatiya Antariksh Station by 2035 (first module ~2028); Indian on the Moon by 2040.
items.source: ISRO/PIB

items.front: DRDO year; IGMDP leader and its five missiles?
items.back: DRDO 1958; IGMDP (1983) led by A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — Prithvi, Agni, Trishul, Akash, Nag ('PATNA').
items.examPoint: DRDO — establishment (1958), labs & Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP)
items.source: DRDO

items.front: Agni-V MIRV test; Mission Shakti?
items.back: Mission Divyastra (Mar 2024) = first Agni-V MIRV test (multiple warheads). Mission Shakti (2019) = ASAT, India 4th nation.
items.source: DRDO/PIB

items.front: Missile roles: BrahMos, Akash, Astra, Nag, Prithvi?
items.back: BrahMos = supersonic cruise (Indo-Russian); Akash = SAM; Astra = BVR air-to-air; Nag = anti-tank; Prithvi = SS ballistic.
items.source: DRDO

items.front: Operation Sindoor (2025) — what and air defence used?
items.back: 7 May 2025 military op: precision strikes on cross-border terror infra; layered air defence — S-400 ('Sudarshan Chakra'), Akash, counter-drone.
items.examPoint: Operation Sindoor (May 2025) — integrated air defence (S-400/Akash) & BrahMos deployment
items.source: MoD/PIB

items.front: AP space assets: SDSC-SHAR, NVS-02 milestone, NARL?
items.back: SDSC-SHAR on Sriharikota (Pulicat barrier island) = primary spaceport; NVS-02 (GSLV-F15, Jan 2025) = 100th SHAR launch; NARL Gadanki = MST radar.
items.examPoint: NVS-02 (GSLV-F15, Jan 2025) — 100th launch from Sriharikota; NavIC second-generation
items.source: ISRO

items.front: What is ISRO's NGLV?
items.back: The Next Generation Launch Vehicle — a reusable-ready heavy-lift rocket under development.
items.examPoint: Launch vehicles — SLV/ASLV/PSLV/GSLV/LVM3/SSLV roles & payload capacity
